tF:ClearAllChildren()table.clear(tL)local txt,rad,aS="WALL HOP",37,math.rad(11.5)local chars={}for i=1,#txt do chars[i]=txt:sub(i,i)end

local op=OverlapParams.new()

RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function()if not en then return end local ch=plr.Character local hum,rt=ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"),ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")if not hum or not rt or not hum.Jump or tick()-lJT<S.CD or(S.PD and gCC(ch,rt)<2)then return end local wN=gWN(ch,rt)if not wN then return end lJT=tick()local wD=Vector3.new(-wN.Z,0,wN.X)if wD.Magnitude>=0.01 then wD=wD.Unit local hV=Vector3.new(rt.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X,0,rt.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)if hV.Magnitude>0.1 and hV:Dot(wD)<0 then wD=-wD end local hS=math.max(hV.Magnitude,8)rt.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(wD.X*hS,S.JV,wD.Z*hS)rt.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(rt.Position,rt.Position+wD)if S.VF then TS:Create(fFr,TweenInfo.new(0.08),{BackgroundTransparency=0.92}):Play()task.delay(0.1,function()TS:Create(fFr,TweenInfo.new(0.2),{BackgroundTransparency=1}):Play()end)end end end)

features:
l tried it in several games, especially one that bans you for using a wall hop script, and it is not detectable—at least I think so. It is the best realistic wall hop so far.

"It only officially supports mobile since it's a floating bubble with an 'X' to close it. It might work on PC because it just needs the bypass, but I can't say for sure, though I'll repeat that the HUB is quite small."

comments.text: Unlike many wall-hop scripts, this one has no jump limits and no wall-detection errors; the only issue is the one I mentioned above. I will keep working on this script to deliver the best and most realistic experience, and the next update will be PC-compatible.

@S1R_Rubo  Actually, I wasn't planning on releasing this, as I’d spent quite a while trying to get the movement just right—ensuring the character wouldn't jump off walls that aren't meant for wall-hopping—but it’s about 95% of the way there.
@LONELY_HUB Whatever you say, the script is good
